name: HVAC Live Transfers

hero.headline: HVAC Live Transfers
hero.subheadline: Connect with high-intent consumers actively looking for hvac solutions.

overview: HVAC Live Transfers are consumers qualified by our team and warm-transferred to your agents, generated by Altarious Global performance campaigns and delivered to your business in real time. Connect homeowners needing heating and cooling repair, replacement or installation with licensed HVAC contractors in their service area.

Live Transfers help HVAC contractors focus their highest-value resources on the right opportunities. Our team confirms the service address, homeownership, system type and whether the need is repair or replacement before warm-transferring to the contractor, so replacement-minded homeowners can be routed to comfort advisors while repair calls go to dispatch. Screening also removes renters, out-of-area callers and those seeking only a second opinion on a quote, which protects CSR and technician time during the busiest weeks of the year.

This product is suited to home services businesses with a team ready to answer during defined hours, a clear view of the consumer they want, and the capacity to convert a live conversation. The acquisition objective is simple: put your team in front of hvac consumers at the moment they are deciding.
targetConsumer: Homeowners in single-family homes with central heating and cooling systems, particularly those with equipment more than ten years old. The highest-value segments are homeowners facing a system replacement, households seeking financing for a new installation, and owners in extreme-climate regions where a failed system creates immediate urgency.
consumerIntent: Typical intent signals include: searching for ac repair, furnace repair or hvac company near me; air conditioner or furnace has stopped working or is not maintaining temperature; system is more than ten to fifteen years old and repairs are becoming frequent; researching new ac unit cost, heat pump installation or hvac financing.
howGenerated: Consumers are acquired through performance campaigns targeting searches such as "AC repair near me" and "HVAC companies near me", plus social and comparison placements. Interested consumers speak with our qualification team before any transfer is attempted.
qualification: Qualification is configured to your appetite. Standard hvac criteria include: property located within the contractor's service area; homeowner or authorised decision maker for the property; type of need identified as repair, replacement, installation or maintenance; single-family or multi-unit property type confirmed; interest in scheduling a service call or in-home estimate; for replacement inquiries, openness to financing or a stated budget range.
delivery: Once qualified, the consumer is bridged directly to your designated number or queue with a warm introduction. Delivery runs only during your operating hours with daily caps, and you can pause or adjust criteria at any time.

faq.q: Can we focus on replacement and installation rather than repair?
faq.a: Yes. Campaign messaging and screening can emphasise system replacement, heat pump installation and financing, and repair-only calls can be limited or excluded.

faq.q: How do you handle seasonal volume swings?
faq.a: Programs can be scaled up ahead of and during peak heating and cooling seasons and reduced in shoulder months, with daily caps adjusted to your technician capacity.
Homeownership or decision-maker status is confirmed during screening so that contractors are not routed renters who cannot authorise repairs or replacements.
